```plato

    //==
    // Chamfered and exactly-filleted CSG.
    //
    // Two alternatives to the polynomial smooth operators above, for when the join
    // between two shapes is a specified DIMENSION rather than an aesthetic choice:
    // a 45-degree bevel, and a true circular arc. `SmoothUnionDistance` is cheaper
    // than either but its blend is a polynomial approximation of an arc, not an arc.
    //
    // Fidelity: every operator here measures against a bevel plane or an arc placed
    // at the seam, which is the true distance only where the two surfaces cross at
    // a right angle. A lower bound there and near it; as the two surfaces approach
    // PARALLEL the seam term inflates by up to sqrt(2) and stops being a bound at
    // all, so divide by that factor before marching a near-tangential join.

    // The union of two distances with a 45-degree chamfer of the given width across
    // the seam. The third term is the distance to the bevel plane, which cuts the
    // corner the plain minimum would leave. Precondition: width is positive.
    // (hg_sdf: fOpUnionChamfer.)
    ChamferUnionDistance(a: Number, b: Number, width: Number): Number
        => a.Min(b).Min((a + b - width) / Number.SqrtTwo);
```
